links.outcome: False inclusion rate with vs without conservative Safety Agent gating, and uncertain (abstention) rate
links.effect: Safety Agent gating reduced false inclusion from 11.63% to 1.16% in the combined 120-pair cohort (McNemar p = 0.002) and from 12.12% to 1.52% in held-out set, with increased uncertain rate.
links.quote: Safety Agent gating reduced the false inclusion rate from 11.63% to 1.16% in the combined 120-pair cohort (McNemar's test, p = 0.002) and from 12.12% to 1.52% in the held-out set, accompanied by an increase in uncertain rate.

links.outcome: False inclusion under missing biomarker and ECOG data in stress test
links.effect: In the TCGA-derived stress test with missing biomarker and ECOG data, all evaluated systems showed zero observed false inclusion.
links.quote: In the TCGA-derived stress test with missing biomarker and ECOG data, all evaluated systems showed zero observed false inclusion.
